* Umbilical venous waveform shows uniphasic forward flow with mild phasic variation.

 

 

* Foetal middle cerebral artery shows high resistance forward flow with mild diastolic

  flow (RI : 0.      ).Cranio-placental flow [ CPF ] ratio is not reversed.

 

 

* Foetal aorta shows normal flow spectrum with preserved peak flow[RI : 0.      ] --- no diastolic

  flow reversal noted.

 

 

* Foetal ductus venosus show normal flow spectrum
